I am an old man now, 81 years, and these beans I plant on my small piece here in Mzimba do not need the chemical fertilizer like maize does — beans make their own goodness in the soil. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens if I have it, and use the seeds I saved from last season because hybrid bean seed is not something we get from FISP anyway. My body is tired, so I will do what I can with my own hands and ask my children or grandchildren to help me weed, but I cannot afford to hire ganyu workers for this small plot.
